entries.notes: ORCL still holds the best backtested edge on the watchlist — a 44.4% win rate over 36 trades and +19.26% cumulative return, the largest trade sample of any ticker here — with NVDA a close second at +18.49% over 17 trades (47.1% win rate). Ten of the eighteen tickers are sitting within 1.5% of their trigger level today, an unusually wide cluster spread fairly evenly across all three tiers: high-tier ORCL, PLTR, CRM, and TSLA; medium-tier META, INFY, and NVDA; and low-tier GOOGL, JPM, and BAC, with META, ORCL, and PLTR each within about 0.2% of triggering. This is a readout of the backtest and trigger levels only — not investment advice.
